description: A dynamic shoulder warmup exercise to lubricate the glenohumeral joint and activate deltoid and upper back musculature.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and extend both arms straight out to your sides at shoulder height.
steps: Extend arms horizontally with palms facing down and core gently braced.
Trace controlled circular paths with your fingertips, gradually increasing circle diameter.
Complete the designated repetitions forward, then reverse the circular rotation backward.
cues: Keep ribs pulled down and neck relaxed
Rotate from the shoulder socket rather than swinging your torso

mistakes.fix: Depress shoulder blades down toward your back pockets throughout circles
Keep glutes and abs lightly braced to stabilize your spine

rep_standard: Each completed full circular revolution counts as one repetition
